professional.title: SLB · 钻速、录井与地层对照

papers.title: Machine Learning-Based Real-Time Lithology Identification From Drilling Data in the Ca Tam Offshore Field
papers.input: 钻压、扭矩、立管压力和钻速等资料
papers.method: 比较RF、XGBoost、SVM与ANN，学习钻进参数到岩性的对应。
papers.boundary: 论文使用真实井岩性资料；本课只解释多通道思路，标签为合成可钻性段。

papers.title: Prediction of rate of penetration in oil and gas well drilling: A hybrid data-driven approach with multi-stage data preprocessing
papers.input: 含异常、噪声和不规则采样的钻进数据
papers.method: 预处理、集成模型与1D-CNN/BiLSTM组合学习钻速。
papers.boundary: 论文任务是ROP预测；本课CNN做逐米分段，未复现整套混合模型。

drawings: Original SVG mechanism drawings, not measured field geometry.
data: Reproducible synthetic teaching data; not sourced from the cited papers.
